_comment: Chapter 6 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F27, Pip (comic): "Sanctum holy water" for 5 gold; it is a red potion with a new label.

text.zh_TW: 皮普在祈禱廳門口擺了一張桌子：「神殿聖水！神明親手祝福！一瓶只要五枚金幣！」凱：「……那是井水吧。」皮普：「是神明的井！」
text.en: Pip has set up a table at the door of the Hall of Prayers. "Sanctum holy water! Blessed by the gods themselves! Only five gold a bottle!" Kai: "...That's well water." Pip: "It's the gods' well!"

text.zh_TW: 你喝了一口。……居然真的有用。瓶底貼著一張小標籤：「紅色藥水（皮普牌）」。
text.en: You take a sip. ...It actually works. A little label is stuck on the bottom: "Red Potion (Pip brand)".
